# The Core as a single point, and the Skin on a link loss (generated by corefail.py)

## The load of N Skins on one Core, delta session

| N | mirror, watts | extend or split, watts | mirror, lit time on `0.9 Wh` | extend, lit time on `0.9 Wh` | N Leafs, lit time each |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.23 | 2.23 | 23.3 min | 23.3 min | 23.3 min |
| 2 | 3.21 | 3.87 | 16.2 min | 13.4 min | 23.3 min |
| 3 | 4.19 | 5.52 | 12.4 min | 9.4 min | 23.3 min |
| 4 | 5.17 | 7.17 | 10.0 min | 7.2 min | 23.3 min |
| 6 | 7.13 | 10.46 | 7.3 min | 5.0 min | 23.3 min |

All `N` Skins share one store, so each Skin gets `1/N` of the lit time. N Leafs hold `N` stores. `[HYPOTHESIS]` the hub scaling.

## The failure cases, N = 3 Skins on one Core, a `0.9 Wh` store

| case | what the user sees | how long to come back | state lost |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 host power lost, the Core store carries | all 3 Skins keep the session for 12 min lit (one Skin: 23 min), then 16 min dark; one store, 3 loads | on a host: the live frame in 0.3 s (Wi-Fi) to 2.4 s (cold 5G) | none finalized; the flush rule holds |
| C2 one Skin link lost | that Skin shows the ROM screen in 15 ms; the other Skins and the session are untouched | relink and the last frame in 109 ms (cable), 76 ms (60 GHz) | none; touches on a dark Skin are lost |
| C3 the Core box dies | all 3 Skins go dark at once; the session lapses after 2 s | Skins on another Core: the live frame in 0.30 s; the Core must be reached by hand | none finalized; up to 7 s if the Core had no other radio path and no flush |
| C4 the validator role fails on the Core | a shadow in another power domain takes over: 4 to 5 frames covered by the Core compositor; the Skins see no break | at once; a cold start without a shadow takes about 130 ms | none |
| C5 a Skin dies | that screen only; the Core and the session are untouched | a new Skin pairs: a wallet action, then the live frame in 0.3 s | none |

## Joint failure: N Skins on one Core against N Leafs

Rates per hour and repair times in seconds, all `[HYPOTHESIS]`: core_box 5.00e-05 per h and 600.0 s, skin_panel 2.00e-05 per h and 3600.0 s, cable_link 2.00e-05 per h and 60.0 s, mmwave_link 2.00e+00 per h and 1.0 s. A Leaf is a Core and a panel in one body. The common-cause share is `{BETA}`.

| N | design | no screen at all, minutes per year | dark screen-minutes per year | events per year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | one Core, N Skins | 15.1 | 15.1 | 0.788 |
| 1 | N Leafs | 14.9 | 14.9 | 0.613 |
| 2 | one Core, N Skins | 4.38 | 30.1 | 1.14 |
| 2 | N Leafs | 0.088 | 29.8 | 1.23 |
| 3 | one Core, N Skins | 4.38 | 45.2 | 1.49 |
| 3 | N Leafs | 0.0876 | 44.7 | 1.84 |
| 4 | one Core, N Skins | 4.38 | 60.3 | 1.84 |
| 4 | N Leafs | 0.0876 | 59.6 | 2.45 |
| 6 | one Core, N Skins | 4.38 | 90.4 | 2.54 |
| 6 | N Leafs | 0.0876 | 89.4 | 3.68 |

With the 60 GHz link in place of the cable, `N = 3`:

| design | no screen at all, minutes per year | dark screen-minutes per year |
|---|---|---|
| split | 4.38 | 920 |
| leafs | 0.0876 | 44.7 |

For `N = 3` the chance that no screen works is `50` times higher with one Core. The dark screen-minutes per year differ by `1.01` times, so the Split moves the risk into one event. It does not add risk of the same kind.

### The host power loss, restarts per year

A host power gap longer than the store ends in a pause and a restart. The gap law is a short mode (mean `60 s`) and a parked mode (`2 %`, mean `4 h`). `[HYPOTHESIS]`

| design | lit time | restarts per year | what restarts |
|---|---|---|---|
| one Core, 1 Skins, `0.9 Wh` | 23.3 min | 1.49 | all 1 Skins at once |
| 1 Leafs, one host, `0.9 Wh` each | 23.3 min | 1.49 | all 1 Leafs at once, on a common host |
| one Core, 3 Skins, `0.9 Wh` | 12.4 min | 1.55 | all 3 Skins at once |
| 3 Leafs, one host, `0.9 Wh` each | 23.3 min | 1.49 | all 3 Leafs at once, on a common host |
| one Core, 6 Skins, `0.9 Wh` | 7.3 min | 1.59 | all 6 Skins at once |
| 6 Leafs, one host, `0.9 Wh` each | 23.3 min | 1.49 | all 6 Leafs at once, on a common host |

The store is the same in both. The restart count rises a little with N. The common host, not the Split, is what restarts everything at once.

## The Core as a single point, by distance class

At C0 and C1 the Core is the device and the screens depend on it. At C2 the Leaf keeps its own silicon, frame store, compositor and U7, and the Core is a validator with replicas.

| class | the Core box dies | what the user sees | how long |
|---|---|---|---|
| C0 or C1, one Core, N Skins | all N screens | dark, then the ROM screen while the store lasts | until another Core: `600 s` assumed, then the live frame in `0.3 s` |
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna, a shadow in another power domain | none of the Leafs go dark | the Leaf frame store and compositor cover `4` to `5` frames, inside the `40 ms` limit | `17 ms` |
| C2 km, 5G cell-site, large Core antenna, no shadow | none of the Leafs go dark | a cold start on the next validator | `133 ms` p50, `152 ms` p99 |
| C2 far, far validator, a shadow in another power domain | none of the Leafs go dark | the Leaf frame store and compositor cover `23` to `25` frames, outside the `40 ms` limit | `96 ms` |
| C2 far, far validator, no shadow | none of the Leafs go dark | a cold start on the next validator | `495 ms` p50, `518 ms` p99 |

**The blast radius grows.** A large C2 Core serves about `100` users. One box death touches all of them in the same instant. A hot shadow costs `76 Mbit/s` per session. A warm shadow costs `0.26 Mbit/s`. A cold start of `100` sessions needs `25.6 MB` of intra frames in about `0.15 s`.

Share of time with no reachable validator, `k` replicas, with the common-cause share `0.02`. This is the real single point at C2.

| fleet | k = 1 | k = 2 | k = 3 | k = 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| stress fleet of net/discovery | 8.68e+03 min per year | 312 min per year | 176 min per year | 174 min per year |
| healthy fleet, one tenth of the crash rate | 875 min per year | 18.9 min per year | 17.5 min per year | 17.5 min per year |

The table counts a validator outage, not a dark screen. At C2 the screen lives on, and the Leaf shows the last frame and the compositor result. The beta term sets the floor: more replicas stop helping when a common cause takes them all.

## Part B: the Skin on a link loss

Detection takes `8.3 ms` (two scan frames without a stream). The ROM screen follows in `6.5 ms`. The Skin never shows a stale frame: it has no frame store, and a stale frame looks live.
